content: The Metroid series is going back to its 2D roots again with Metroid Ravenous for the Nintendo Switch 2, the first side-scrolling game in the series since 2021’s Metroid Dread for the Nintendo Switch. If you’re already excited enough to consider preordering, you can save $10 on the physical version of the game when you buy it from Walmart. It’s $59.88 instead of $69.99, about the same as buying it digitally. The game launches on January 28th, 2027, but it’s not clear how long the preorder discount will last. If it’s anything like other Walmart preorders, it may occasionally disappear. [Product: Metroid Ravenous | https://goto.walmart.com/c/482924/565706/9383?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.walmart.com%2Fip%2FMetroid-Ravenous-Nintendo-Switch-2%2F20973300457] Nintendo first showed off the side-scrolling adventure game at its September 2026 Direct, with a frantic trailer cutting between cinematic sequences, Samus dashing and rolling across a variety of environments, and engaging a number of enemies and bosses in battle. Samus absorbs some powerful abilities at the conclusion of Dread, and Ravenous seem to be all about plowing through anyone stopping her from escaping the planet. Other details of the story, including unique new mechanics, are being kept under wraps for the time being. If you haven’t played Metroid Dread, I recommend it, especially at its $41.99 discounted price at Amazon. It’s part of Nintendo’s “Customer Appreciation” sale happening through September 26th, and several other games and accessories are cheaper, too.
chineseTitle: 沃尔玛降低了《银河战士：贪婪》实体预购的价格
chineseSummary: 《银河战士》系列将再次回归 2D 根源，推出 Nintendo Switch 2 版《银河战士贪婪》，这是继 2021 年任天堂 Switch 版《银河战士恐惧》之后该系列的首款横向卷轴游戏。如果您已经足够兴奋并考虑预订，那么当您 [...] 时，您可以在游戏的实体版本上节省 10 美元
chineseContent: 《银河战士》系列将再次回归 2D 根源，推出 Nintendo Switch 2 版《银河战士贪婪》，这是继 2021 年任天堂 Switch 版《银河战士恐惧》之后该系列的首款横向卷轴游戏。如果您已经兴奋地考虑预订，那么从沃尔玛购买游戏实体版可以节省 10 美元。它的价格是 59.88 美元，而不是 69.99 美元，与数字购买的价格大致相同。该游戏将于 2027 年 1 月 28 日推出，但尚不清楚预购折扣会持续多久。如果它像其他沃尔玛预购一样，它可能偶尔会消失。 [产品：银河战士贪婪 | https://goto.walmart.com/c/482924/565706/9383?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.walmart.com%2Fip%2FMetroid-Ravenous-Nintendo-Switch-2%2F20973300457]任天堂在 2026 年 9 月的直面会上首次展示了这款横向卷轴冒险游戏，并在中间插入了一段疯狂的预告片电影场景中，萨姆斯在各种环境中冲锋滚滚，并与许多敌人和头目交战。萨姆斯在《恐惧》的结尾吸收了一些强大的能力，而《贪婪》似乎就是要铲除任何阻止她逃离地球的人。故事的其他细节，包括独特的新机制，目前仍处于保密状态。如果你还没有玩过《银河战士恐惧》，我推荐它，尤其是亚马逊的折扣价为 41.99 美元。这是 9 月 26 日之前任天堂“顾客答谢”促销活动的一部分，其他几款游戏和配件也更便宜。
